newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds were firmer, with activity concentrated in Swiss federal government bonds before final terms are set on a new confederate bond on Thursday.
The government is likely announce terms around 1100 GMT, and will also publish them on monitor page SWIW.
Traders said the new bond, with a 3-1/2 percent coupon maturing in August 2010, was volatile before the auction ended.
It was quoted in late trade on Wednesday at 3.67 percent.
One trader said that it appeared there were some short positions in the new issue which made it hard to judge how it will be priced.
Comi medium-term bond futures settle at 113.64
Euro Swiss francs down one basis point at 98.48.
